name: BAUTO
recent: Bermaz Auto 近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动申报，同时公司在公开市场进行股份回购。公司也宣布终止在马来西亚分销 Xpeng 品牌。最新季度营收同比增 12.6%，但净利环比下滑 13.1%。
notable: 公司终止在马来西亚分销 Xpeng 品牌。
多名董事及大股东在 11 月 16 日至 19 日期间申报持股变动，涉及在公开市场增持股份。
公司于 11 月 16 日至 19 日期间多次进行股份回购。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门期间（closed period）进行股份交易。
公司终止 Xpeng 品牌分销，涉及业务范围调整。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 MYR 553.08 million，同比增 12.6%，环比增 1.5%；净利为 MYR 40.51 million，同比增 389.3%，环比减 13.1%；净利率为 7.3%，低于上一季度的 8.6%。

news.title: Bermaz Auto ceases Xpeng distribution in Malaysia

events.what: 下一季 (10 月底结束) 季报最迟公布日 · 交易所规定
events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Oct (Bursa rule)

recent_en: Bermaz Auto recently saw multiple director and substantial shareholder interest change announcements, alongside share buybacks in the open market. The company also announced the cessation of Xpeng distribution in Malaysia. Latest quarterly revenue rose 12.6% YoY, while net profit fell 13.1% QoQ.
notable_en: The company ceased Xpeng distribution in Malaysia.
Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in interest between 16 and 19 November, involving acquisitions of shares in the open market.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks between 16 and 19 November.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period.
The company ceased Xpeng brand distribution, involving a business scope adjustment.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 553.08 million, up 12.6% YoY and 1.5% QoQ; net profit was MYR 40.51 million, up 389.3% YoY but down 13.1% QoQ; net margin was 7.3%, lower than 8.6% in the previous quarter.
